Bacterial Pathogen: Streptococcus pneumoniae, Neisseria meningitidis, Streptococcus suis (Asia)
Clinical Features: Often very rapid onset with high fever and meningism, cranial nerve involvement less common
CSF Features: Often cloudy, high leukocyte cell count, predominance of polymorphs, low glucose

Clinical Features: Often a history of several days of illness, onset less abrupt, cranial nerve involvement common
CSF Features: Often clear, high CSF protein, low CSF glucose

Clinical Features: Often subacute onset, severe headache common, cranial nerve involvement common
CSF Features: CSF can be normal in at least 25% of cases
